```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Overview

This code creates day of burning (DOB) maps for each fire following methods outlined by Parks et al. [-@parks2014MappingDayofburningCoarseresolution]. The following code is modified from code used in Harris et al. [-@harris2025AspenImpedesWildfire].

```{r}
#CO
CO<- st_read("data/raw/States/cb_2018_us_state_20m.shp") %>% 
   filter(STUSPS =="CO") %>%
   st_transform("EPSG:5070") %>% # transform to Albers Equal-Area Conic (USGS)
   st_union() 

fires <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "fires") %>% # import selected perimeters
  mutate(Fire_ID=Event_ID) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(Ig_Date, "%Y%m%d")) %>% 
  mutate(Fire_Year=as.character(year)) %>%
  mutate(Fire_Month = lubridate::month(date)) %>%
  mutate(Fire_Day = lubridate::day(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Fire_ID, Incid_Name, Fire_Year, Fire_Month, Fire_Day) %>% 
  st_transform("EPSG:5070")
  #filter(Fire_ID != "CO4071610803320140723") #Alkali - too few hotspots for kriging having issues with this one
 
wfigs <- st_read("data/raw/WFIGS/WFIGS_Interagency_Perimeters_-6137106134146866405.gpkg") %>% 
  filter(poly_FeatureCategory=="Wildfire Final Fire Perimeter") %>% #(n=16775)
  st_transform("EPSG:5070") %>%# transform to Albers Equal-Area Conic (USGS)
  st_crop(CO) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR=lubridate::year(attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime)) %>% 
  mutate(start.doy= lubridate::yday(attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime)) %>%
  mutate(contain.doy= lubridate::yday(attr_ControlDateTime)) %>%
  mutate(STARTMONTH = lubridate::month(attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime)) %>%
  mutate(STARTDAY = lubridate::day(attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime))

```

## Modified code from HartLab modified from harris paper

```{r}
for (j in unique(fires$Fire_ID)){ #for each unique fire_id, call it j
  if(!file.exists(here("data", "processed", "DOB",  paste0(j, "_DOB.tif")))){ #if the day of burning file does not already exist
    basegrid <- rast(here("data", "processed", "GEE", "FireSeverity", "CBI", paste0(j, "_CBI_bc.tif")))  #load the cbi raster created in GEE
    basegrid[] <- 1 # replace all values with 0 - ask Sarah if I did this or her, why 1? try also 0
    
    perimeter <- fires[fires$Fire_ID == j, ] #index fires to the jth fire id, and keep all the columns
    
    #1.1 Add start and end dates using WFIGS or MTBS (if outside WFIGS years, complete data starting 2021)
    if(perimeter$Fire_Year %in% 2021:2024){ 
      centroidj<- st_centroid(perimeter) 
      wfigsj <- wfigs %>% filter(YEAR == perimeter$Fire_Year) #filter wfigs to the year of the fire
      wfigsj <- st_join(centroidj, wfigsj, join = st_within, left = FALSE) #find centroidj within wfigs and return only rows from centroidj that match, with all columns and centroid geometry
      perimeter <- perimeter %>%  
        mutate(STARTDATE=as.Date(paste( wfigsj$YEAR, wfigsj$STARTMONTH, wfigsj$STARTDAY, sep="-"))) %>% 
        mutate(ENDDATE=as.Date(paste(year(wfigsj$attr_ContainmentDateTime), month(wfigsj$attr_ContainmentDateTime), day(wfigsj$attr_ContainmentDateTime), sep="-") )) #add the start date and end date to our perimeter object from wfigs
    }else{ #if NOT a 2021-2024 fire
      wfigsj <- wfigs %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% summarize(start=min(as.numeric(start.doy), na.rm=T), end=max(as.numeric(contain.doy), na.rm=T)) #take the range of fire start/contain dates within the wfigs dataset
      perimeter <- perimeter %>%  
        mutate(STARTDATE=as.Date(paste(perimeter$Fire_Year, perimeter$Fire_Month, perimeter$Fire_Day, sep="-"))) %>% 
        mutate(ENDDATE=365) # why take min and max from wfigs if not used? how does 365 work if other dates are formatted differently?
    }
    
    perimeter <- terra::project(vect(perimeter), crs(basegrid))
    
    # 1.2 Process hotspots. Here we assume FIRMs ------------------------------
    modis_hotspots <- read.csv(here("data", "raw", "Fire", "MODIS", "modis", perimeter$Fire_Year, paste0("modis_", perimeter$Fire_Year, "_United_States.csv")))
    if(perimeter$Fire_Year %in% 2012:2024){
      viirs_hotspots <- read.csv(here("data", "raw", "Fire", "VIIRS", "viirs-snpp", perimeter$Fire_Year, paste0("viirs-snpp_", perimeter$Fire_Year, "_United_States.csv")))
    
      names(viirs_hotspots) <- names(modis_hotspots)
      hotspots  <- rbind(modis_hotspots, viirs_hotspots)
    }else{
      hotspots  <- modis_hotspots
    }
    
    hotspots$JDAY <- as.numeric(lubridate::yday(hotspots$acq_date))
    hotspots$ACQ_TIME <- as.numeric(format(hotspots$acq_time, digits=4))/2400
    hotspots$YEAR  <- lubridate::year(hotspots$acq_date)
    hotspots$JDAYDEC  <- hotspots$JDAY + hotspots$ACQ_TIME

    #Crop to perimeter date. In this case, maximum allowable error is 30 days.
    hotspots <- hotspots %>% dplyr::filter(YEAR == perimeter$Fire_Year, 
                                           JDAY >= lubridate::yday(perimeter$STARTDATE) - 30)
    
    hotspots <- hotspots %>%  st_as_sf(coords=c("longitude", "latitude"), crs=st_crs("EPSG:4326")) %>% vect()    
    hotspots <- terra::project(hotspots, crs(basegrid))
    
    #Spatially crop to perimeter + 1000 m
    perimeter_buf <- terra::buffer(perimeter, 1000)
    hotspots      <- terra::crop(hotspots, perimeter_buf) 
    
    # 2.0 Interpolate Fire Arrival --------------------------------------------
    # Here we use the subset hotspots and pre-defined perimeter to interpolate fire arrival time using kriging
    grid.fire <- terra::crop(basegrid, perimeter)
    grid.fire <- terra::rasterize(perimeter, grid.fire, fun="max", field=0)
    
    grid.pt <- stars::st_as_stars(grid.fire)
    grid.pt <- st_as_sf(grid.pt, as_points = TRUE, merge = FALSE)
    
    #Time zone correction - here assume daylight savings time and only one time zone
    # All observations are in Mountain Time daylight savings (UTC-6)
    timezone_offset <- -6  # hours
    hotspots$JDAYDEC <- hotspots$JDAYDEC + timezone_offset/24
    hotspots <- st_as_sf(hotspots) #gstat needs sf
    #kriging
    dob.kriged <- gstat::variogram(JDAYDEC ~ 1, hotspots)
    dob.fit <- gstat::fit.variogram(dob.kriged, gstat::vgm(c("Exp", "Sph", "Mat")))
    dob.fit <- dob.fit %>% filter(range>=0)
    dob.kriged <- krige(JDAYDEC~1, hotspots, grid.pt, model=dob.fit, nmax=6)
    
    # Assign values to grid, using GRID.FIRE as a base raster
    grid.jday <- grid.fire
    grid.jday[!is.na(grid.jday)] <- dob.kriged$var1.pred
  
    grid.jday <- trunc(grid.jday)
    writeRaster(grid.jday, here("data", "processed", "DOB",  paste0(perimeter$Fire_ID, "_DOB.tif")), overwrite=T)
    

    #Daily spread estimation - assuming circular growth. Note this biases later fires day to unestimated growth

    PTS <- as.points(grid.jday) %>% st_as_sf()
    names(PTS)[1] <- "DOB"
    
    DOB <- as.polygons(grid.jday)%>% st_as_sf()
    names(DOB)[1] <- "DOB"
      
    DOB$firearea <- st_area(DOB)
    DOB$firearea <- units::set_units(DOB$firearea, ha)
    
    DOB <- DOB %>% group_by(DOB) %>% summarise(firearea = sum(as.numeric(firearea)))
    DOB <- DOB %>% mutate(firearea = ifelse(is.na(firearea), 0, firearea))
    DOB$cumuarea <- cumsum(DOB$firearea)
    DOB$fireday <- DOB$DOB - min(DOB$DOB) + 1
    DOB$sprdistm <- 2*((DOB$cumuarea * 10000/pi)^0.5 - ((DOB$cumuarea*10000-DOB$firearea*10000)/pi)^0.5) # *2 for unidirectional growth
    
    ## Calculate bearing to previous day of burning polygon
    DOB$dir <- NA 
    DOB <- DOB %>% arrange(DOB)
    for(k in unique(DOB$DOB)){
       DOBk <- DOB %>% filter(DOB==k)
      if(k>min(DOB$DOB)){
        pDOB <- DOB %>% filter(DOB<k) %>% arrange(desc(DOB)) %>% slice(1)
        pDOB.c <- pDOB %>% st_centroid() %>% st_coordinates() # centroid
        DOBk.c <- DOBk %>% st_centroid() %>% st_coordinates() # centroid
        DOB[DOB$DOB==k, ]$dir <- geosphere::bearing(pDOB.c, DOBk.c)
      }
    }
    DOB$FIRE_ID <- j
    st_write(DOB, here("data", "processed", "DOB",  paste0(perimeter$Fire_ID, "_DOB.gpkg")), overwrite=T)
  }
}
```
